cities.generationInstructions: The rear tip of the ORIGINAL plinth is at y400 in the 1254px canvas, not y290. Keep it there. Do not extend the floor backwards to fit more houses. The rear-most buildings must fit inside that rear edge; the sky above it remains ivory. The Obelisk rises above the floor, but no rear paving or housing district beyond the input floor. Use only compact landmarks and a contained foreground bridge/channel.

cities.notes: Excepción al nombre del modo autorizada por el usuario: la respuesta será Machu Picchu, no Cusco ni una ciudad moderna.
